hooks.prompt:
BEFORE answering this prompt, evaluate: does it involve architecture, technology choices, design patterns, past decisions, known bugs/constraints, project conventions, or infrastructure? If YES — search Hindsight memory FIRST by running: bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/do-recall.sh low <<'EOF'
<relevant search query>
EOF
Then use the results to inform your answer. If the prompt is about simple code edits, formatting, confirmations, or trivial tasks — proceed without recall.

Before compaction, save unsaved important knowledge to Hindsight memory. Review conversation for: 1) Decisions with reasoning 2) Technology choices 3) Bug solutions (root cause + fix) 4) Tradeoffs made 5) Constraints/workarounds discovered 6) Conventions established 7) Negative decisions (what was rejected and why). For each, use: bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/do-retain.sh <category> <<'EOF'
<WHAT + WHY>
EOF
Categories: architecture, tech-stack, patterns, decisions, tradeoffs, bugs, lessons, requirements, conventions. Retain is async (non-blocking). Save 2-5 items. Skip if nothing significant.
